title: A query table is used with TREATAS to filter the column it was built from
query: "Sales Amount", CALCULATE ( [Sales Amount], TREATAS ( { Colors[Color] }, Product[Color] ) ) )

source.quote: The following example shows using a query table in a DAX query.
source.supports: the page gives this query shape: ADDCOLUMNS over Colors with TREATAS onto Product[Color]

derivation: For each row of Colors, TREATAS applies its color as a filter on Product[Color]: Red rows 1, 2, 3, 5, 7 = 460; Blue rows 4, 6 = 80; Green has no sales, BLANK.
